name: Pinpointed AI Sommelier
author: pinpointed

sections.description:
Pinpointed AI Sommelier is a conversational AI product expert for your WooCommerce store.

Instead of forcing customers to scroll through searches, filters, and hundreds of bottles, it asks natural-language questions such as:

  • “What are you cooking?”
  • “What’s your budget per bottle?”
  • “Is this a gift? Who is it for?”

Then it recommends the best wines or spirits from your live WooCommerce inventory, with direct links to product pages so customers can buy in one click.

The result: more confident buyers, higher average order values and fewer “I don’t know what to choose” drop-offs.

Key features

  • 💬 Floating AI chat widget
    A slick, mobile-friendly chat bubble that appears on every page or only where you choose.

  • 🍷 Wine & spirits expert out of the box
    Pre-tuned to talk about wine, sparkling, spirits and gifts. No prompt-engineering required.

  • 🛒 Works with live WooCommerce products
    Searches your real catalog, including price, availability and product URLs.

  • 🎯 Budget & occasion aware
    Asks about budget, occasion, food pairings and preferences, then narrows recommendations.

  • 📈 Upsell-friendly logic
    Nudges shoppers to slightly higher-value bottles when appropriate while respecting their budget.

  • 🌍 Multi-store & multi-currency friendly
    Reads your WooCommerce currency and pricing. Works with any theme.

  • 🔒 Privacy-conscious by design
    No emails or personal identifiers required. No identifiable data is sent to the AI.

  • 🧩 Shortcode or global load
    Use [pinpointed_ai_sommelier] on specific pages or enable it globally across the site.

How it works (high level)

  1. The plugin adds a small floating AI chat button to your storefront.
  2. When customers ask questions, the plugin securely calls the Pinpointed gateway (hosted on Cloudflare Workers).
  3. The gateway talks to your AI workflow (e.g. n8n / Pinpointed backend) and your WooCommerce products.
  4. The customer sees a friendly, natural reply with clickable product links.

You can start on a Free plan and upgrade later to Starter or Pro inside the WordPress admin.

SaaS & data usage notice

This plugin connects to the Pinpointed AI service in order to function. The plugin loads a JavaScript widget from an external domain (Cloudflare Workers) to provide the chat functionality.

  • Remote service: pinpointed-gateway.ian-d13.workers.dev
  • External script: The chat widget is loaded from the Pinpointed gateway URL specified in your settings
  • Data sent: customer questions, chat session ID, store domain, currency meta, and product search terms
  • Data not sent by default: customer names, emails, billing/shipping details or WordPress user data

Important: The plugin loads JavaScript from an external Cloudflare Workers domain to provide the AI chat widget. This is necessary for the plugin to function but means that chat functionality depends on the availability of this external service.

By activating the plugin and requesting a license, you agree that your store will communicate with the Pinpointed AI service. You can remove the plugin at any time to stop all calls.

For details, see the Pinpointed AI Sommelier Terms & Conditions: https://pinpointed.dev/woocommerce-ai-sommelier-plugin-terms-conditions

Privacy Policy: When you use this plugin, it collects chat messages and anonymous session data to provide wine recommendations. It does NOT collect customer names, emails, or payment information. For full details, see the Privacy section in your WordPress admin under Settings → Privacy.

External Services

This plugin relies on external services to function:

Pinpointed AI Service
– Service URL: https://pinpointed-gateway.ian-d13.workers.dev (configurable)
– Purpose: Provides AI-powered wine and spirits recommendations
– Data sent: Chat messages, anonymous session IDs, store domain, currency information
– Terms of Service: https://pinpointed.dev/woocommerce-ai-sommelier-plugin-terms-conditions
– Privacy Policy: https://pinpointed.dev/privacy

Cloudflare Workers
– Purpose: Hosts the chat widget JavaScript and gateway API
– The plugin loads external JavaScript from your configured gateway URL
– This is necessary for the AI chat functionality to work

By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data will be transmitted to these external services. You can remove the plugin at any time to stop this data transmission.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin
  • Download the plugin ZIP (pinpointed-ai-sommelier.zip).
  • In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  • Upload the ZIP, click Install Now, then Activate.

  1. Check WooCommerce is active

    This plugin requires WooCommerce. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active on your site.

  2. Open Pinpointed AI settings

  • Go to Pinpointed AI in the left-hand admin menu.
  • The Gateway URL will normally be pre-filled.

  1. Create or enter your license

    You have two options:

  • One-click Free plan
    Click “Get a Free Trial License”. The plugin will contact the Pinpointed gateway using your site URL and admin email and create a free license automatically. The new license key will be filled into the License Key field.

  • Existing license
    Paste a license key you received from Pinpointed into the License Key field.

  1. Save and authenticate
  • Click Save & Authenticate.

  • The plugin will bind your license to this domain and request a secure token (JWT) so the chat widget can communicate with the gateway.

    You should see a “Connected” status badge once this is successful.

  1. Decide where to show the widget
  • To show the AI Sommelier on all WooCommerce pages (shop, product, cart, etc.), select “Floating button on all shop pages” in Display Mode.
  • Or select “Only using shortcode” and add [pinpointed_ai_sommelier] to specific pages (e.g. your shop or a dedicated “Ask the Sommelier” page).

  1. Test it

    Visit your store while logged out (or in a private window). You should see a small chat icon at the bottom right. Click it, ask for a pairing, and confirm it returns your WooCommerce products.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Pinpointed account?

No manual account creation is required for the Free plan.

When you click “Get a Free Trial License” in the settings, the plugin securely calls the Pinpointed gateway and creates a free license bound to your store URL. You can later upgrade to Starter or Pro from the same screen.

What’s included in the Free, Starter and Pro plans?

  • Free — ideal for testing and small stores

    • Up to ~30 AI conversations per month (fair use)
    • Core wine & spirits pairing logic

  • Starter — for growing stores ($19/month)

    • Up to 500 AI conversations per month
    • Priority pairing logic updates
    • Email support

  • Pro — for active wine & spirits retailers ($39/month)

    • Up to 2,500 AI conversations per month
    • Priority support
    • Advanced analytics & export

Billing is handled via Stripe Checkout from inside your WordPress admin.

Does this send personal customer data to Pinpointed or the AI provider?

By default, no personally identifying information is sent.

The plugin sends:

  • The visitor’s question(s)
  • Anonymous session ID
  • Store domain and currency meta
  • Product search parameters (to query WooCommerce)

It does not send customer names, emails, addresses or order details unless you explicitly customise your integration to do so.

Does it work with my theme and other plugins?

The chat widget is theme-agnostic and sits above your site content. It should work with most modern WooCommerce themes.

If you use aggressive optimisation tools (minifiers, script blockers, etc.) make sure they don’t block the Pinpointed widget script loaded from the external gateway URL.

Why does the plugin load JavaScript from an external domain?

The AI chat widget is hosted on Cloudflare Workers for optimal performance and reliability. This means the widget JavaScript is loaded from an external URL (your configured gateway URL). This is necessary for the plugin to function. The external script only loads on WooCommerce pages when the widget is enabled.

Can I change the branding / icon?

The default widget uses a Pinpointed chat icon and “Pinpointed AI Sommelier” brand line.

Pro and Enterprise plans can support custom branding. Contact us via the link in the plugin settings or the Pinpointed website for details.

Does it support languages other than English?

The assistant can respond in multiple languages depending on your backend configuration. The plugin includes translation-ready functions for French, German, and Dutch.

Is there a shortcode?

Yes. Use:

[pinpointed_ai_sommelier]

on any page or post where you want to ensure the widget scripts are loaded (for example, a dedicated “Ask our AI Sommelier” page). If “Floating button on all shop pages” is enabled, you don’t need the shortcode.
sections.changelog:
1

  • Added Stripe upgrade buttons (Starter/Pro) inside the admin settings.
  • Introduced fair-use note for Pro plan and terms & conditions link.
  • Improved admin UX, moved settings to a top-level “Pinpointed AI” menu.
  • Minor styling and accessibility tweaks to the chat widget.
  • Added privacy policy declaration for GDPR compliance.
  • Added deactivation hook to clean up scheduled events.
  • Enhanced security: improved nonce verification and input validation.
  • Code quality improvements: better caching and internationalization.

0.1.2

  • New floating chat layout with improved mobile handling.
  • Signed WooCommerce search endpoint for secure product lookups.
  • Internal licensing and tenant binding improvements.

0.1.1

  • Initial public beta of the AI Sommelier widget for WooCommerce.
